definitions.gloss: dating activities; actively seeking a romantic partner
definitions.explanation: The practice of actively participating in social events, using dating apps, or otherwise making deliberate efforts to find a romantic partner. A modern coined word modeled on 就活 (job hunting).

examples.japanese: {恋活|こいかつ}アプリに{登録|とうろく}した。
examples.english: I signed up for a dating app.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{誘|さそ}われて{恋活|こいかつ}パーティーに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I was invited by a friend to join a matchmaking party.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しくて{恋活|こいかつ}する{時間|じかん}がなかったが、{最近|さいきん}やっと{余裕|よゆう}ができた。
examples.english: I was too busy with work to do any dating activities, but recently I finally have some time.

notes:
A modern abbreviation of {恋愛|れんあい}{活動|かつどう} (romance activities), coined following the pattern of {就活|しゅうかつ} (job hunting) and {婚活|こんかつ} (marriage-seeking activities). Refers to the deliberate, proactive pursuit of a romantic relationship, especially through organized events or dating services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恋活|こいかつ}アプリ: dating app
- {恋活|こいかつ}パーティー: matchmaking/singles party
- {恋活|こいかつ}サイト: dating website
- {恋活|こいかつ}する: to actively pursue dating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {婚活|こんかつ}: marriage-seeking activities — specifically aimed at finding a marriage partner, more serious than {恋活|こいかつ}
- {出会|であ}い: meeting, encounter — a more general term for meeting potential romantic partners
- {合|ごう}コン: group blind date — a specific social event format where groups of men and women meet
